title: Envelope codec and schema-enforced validation with size limits
goal: Decode, validate and re-encode every inbound frame strictly against the generated schemas with hard size limits, so nothing malformed or oversized reaches sequencing and fan-out.
scope_in: Decode stage (order 10): text frames only, UTF-8 JSON, max 262144 bytes (256 KiB) per frame, JSON nesting depth <= 16.

Envelope validation with the B003 generated validators; per-kind mode check (clear / encrypted / hybrid) from `events.schema.json`; client-forbidden fields (`from`, `ts`, `seq`) stripped, never trusted.
Limits: `ct` <= 192 KiB serialised, `queue.submit.p.size` <= 196608, `id` must be a `msg_` ULID for client sequenced frames, `sid` must equal the connection's session.
Unknown frame types allowed only if prefixed `sys.`-less unknown event kinds (`k`) under known `t`; unknown `k` is passed on untouched; unknown `t` -> invalid.
Canonical outbound encoder that emits only schema-known envelope fields.
Invalid-frame accounting: `sys.error` `invalid_frame`, close 4400 after > 10 invalid frames in 60 s.
scope_out: Authorisation by role (B043), rate limiting (B041), content signature verification (optional, not in v1).
Heartbeat frames semantics (B040) beyond schema validation.
build_against: The mock client simulator from B011 (scripted fake clients speaking the WS protocol), the in-memory B009 KV/pub-sub implementations, and the frame fixtures in contracts/fixtures/events/; no real client is needed. Golden frames are every file in contracts/fixtures/events/ (valid) plus mutated copies produced by a fuzzer.
interfaces: TS: `decodeFrame(raw: string | Buffer, isBinary: boolean, sid: string): { ok: true; frame: InboundFrame } | { ok: false; code: 'invalid_frame' | 'frame_too_large'; pointer?: string }`
TS: `encodeFrame(frame: OutboundFrame): string` (stable key order `v,t,id,sid,from,ts,seq,ack,ref,k,p,ct,sig`, only known fields).
Wire: `sys.error` with problem+json body in `p` (CT-ERR) for every rejection.
acceptance: A text frame of exactly 262144 bytes is accepted; 262145 bytes yields `sys.error` (status 413-class, code for frame size) and the frame is not routed; a binary frame yields close 4400.

Every valid fixture in contracts/fixtures/events/*.json passes `decodeFrame`; flipping its mode (adding `p` to an encrypted kind such as `message.user`, or removing `ct`) fails with `invalid_frame` and a JSON-pointer.
Unknown `k` under `t:'event'` with a `p` object passes unchanged; unknown `t` fails; unknown extra top-level fields are dropped from the decoded frame (`encodeFrame` of it contains none).
A client-supplied `from`, `ts` or `seq` never survives decoding (property test: for 1 000 random frames the decoded object has none of them).
A frame with `sid` different from the connection's session is rejected `invalid_frame` and counts toward the invalid-frame budget.
The 11th invalid frame within 60 s closes the connection with 4400; 10 invalid frames spread over 61 s do not.
`ct` of 196609 bytes is rejected, 196608 accepted; JSON nested 17 levels deep is rejected.
Decoding a 256 KiB frame takes < 5 ms p95; fuzzing 100 000 random byte strings never throws out of `decodeFrame`.
tests: codec.fixtures.test.ts: all valid fixtures accepted, all mutated rejected.
codec.limits.test.ts: boundary sizes, depth, binary frames.
codec.budget.test.ts: invalid-frame counter with fake clock.
codec.fuzz.test.ts: random bytes and structured fuzz.
codec.encode.test.ts: stable ordering, only known fields.
guardrails: Validation MUST use the generated validators; never hand-write envelope types (GUIDELINES section 2).
The relay MUST NOT parse, decode or log `ct`; size and shape checks only. Error pointers MUST NOT echo values from `p` or `ct`.
Server-set fields (`from`, `ts`, `seq`) MUST be removed from client input before any further stage; trusting a client `from` allows impersonation.
Unknown event kinds MUST still be accepted for sequencing (CT-WS-SESSION-EVENTS 'Unknown kinds'); do not close the connection for them.
The size check MUST run on the raw payload before JSON parsing (no unbounded parse of an oversized message).
failure_modes: Invalid UTF-8 or invalid JSON -> `sys.error` `invalid_frame`, counts toward the budget, connection stays open until the budget is exceeded.
Validator package missing a newer kind -> treated as unknown kind (pass-through), never as an error.
Exception in validation -> caught, frame dropped, `relay_codec_errors_total` incremented, connection kept.
